limitations: EPSG:3857 areas are projected areas, not legal-survey or geodesic ground areas.
Raster statistics and descriptive colors do not change sampled model inputs, scores, crop order or annual factor grades.
Current humidity and estimated NPK are point/model products; no raster coverage or nutrient heatmap is inferred.
spatial_assessment.coverage_method: Valid cell intersection area / complete parcel area in EPSG:3857; edge cells use their clipped area. Counts are analysis-grid cells, not independent field samples. Missing values remain missing.
spatial_assessment.statistics_method: Min/max of intersecting valid cells; mean, median and population standard deviation weighted by exact parcel-cell intersection area. Median uses midpoint on an exact half-area tie.
